title: Automatic project .gitignore injection for .cvh local runtime
summary: Implemented automatic .gitignore synchronization for CanbanVoimaxHarness local runtime in Rust desktop backend. Added ensure_project_gitignore(repo_root: &Path) in src-tauri/src/config.rs which verifies <repo_root>/.gitignore exists (creates if missing), verifies required CVH runtime entries (.cvh/harness.db*, .cvh/spill/, .cvh/worktrees/, .cvh/llm.json, .cvh/tasks.json), verifies directory wildcard coverage (.cvh/, .cvh, **/.cvh/, etc.), and cleanly appends missing lines under '# CanbanVoimaxHarness Local Runtime' without duplicating lines or headers. Hooked ensure_project_gitignore into project initialization (init_project_harness, scaffold_cvh_project), project opening (open_project, set_active_project, select_project_folder), and startup (discover_project_root). Added .cvh/harness.db* to root .gitignore. Added 6 comprehensive unit tests covering creation, append, idempotency, wildcard protection, partial preservation, and harness initialization.
commitMessage: feat(config): automatic project .gitignore injection for .cvh local runtime
